scope: Cave/attack response ordering and departure termination through the creature attack destiny sequence.
method: GEMP fixture reuses the prior real slug deployment fixture. Actual attack commands produce all timing windows. Native uses real commands on component-only boards.
The timing fixture deliberately returns the target ship to hand at seven boundaries to isolate termination. It does not claim that a specific removal card can act at all seven boundaries.

Event trace maps GEMP CHANGED_ASTEROID_CAVE_OR_SPACE_SLUG_BELLY/PLAY/ATTACK_TARGET_SELECTED/ATTACK_INITIATED/weapon segment to cave/deployed/target/initiated/weapons. Native maps its corresponding public event names to the same vocabulary. Recorded observation rows are otherwise compared unchanged.

Native follows the immediate-end rule while preserving already initiated nested card actions, payments, pending choices and physical destiny cleanup. A departure remains latched even if a ship returns before the nested action finishes.
